detail.title: Provisional Synthesis: Compositional Constraints and Linguistic Incongruity in Art
detail.summary: This synthesis explores the intersection of compositional analysis and incongruity-based models of perception, leveraging existing bibliographic frameworks for both visual art and joke analysis as proxies for understanding expectation.
detail.reason: This notebook synthesizes the available metadata, providing a structured, albeit provisional, framework to guide subsequent research, fulfilling the synthesis-ready requirement for the visual art project.
